Salesforce Commerce FAQ
What is Commerce Cloud ?
Commerce Cloud is the
best ecommerce platform
for customer companies. Automate sales across the entire customer lifecycle by embedding
AI-driven commerce
everywhere — from flexible digital storefronts to embedded apps for sales, service, and marketing.
Commerce Cloud helps you manage your
digital commerce
business and grow your sales. Whether you have a
B2B
,
B2C
, or
D2C
ecommerce business, Commerce Cloud has the tools you need to succeed.
Commerce Cloud's ecommerce software offers features like
headless commerce
,
composable commerce
, order management, and payments. You can also integrate Commerce Cloud with your CRM software to track customer data and personalize their shopping experience.
Commerce Cloud is the ultimate
ecommerce platform
.
What does Commerce Cloud do?
Commerce Cloud helps brands launch sooner, grow faster, and reach more customers. Leveraging the power of the cloud, our trusted technology will help you craft innovative customer experiences that drive higher conversions and average order value (AOV), productivity, and inspire brand loyalty. With artificial intelligence infused into the platform, we enable 1-to-1 personalization without the need for data scientists. Our robust technology partner ecosystem and our team of industry experts ensure your growth from planning to launch, and beyond.
What are the components of Commerce Cloud?
Commerce Cloud includes everything you need for a complete unified commerce experience including digital storefronts, customer acquisition and loyalty tools, reporting and insights,
order management
, payments, and embedded apps.
Is Salesforce Commerce Cloud the same as Demandware?
In 2016 Salesforce completed the acquisition of Demandware which is now a part of Commerce Cloud.
What are the benefits of using an ecommerce platform?
An
ecommerce platform
will help you seamlessly launch and grow your digital business through a prebuilt infrastructure. This allows you to reach new customers, reduce operational costs, and grow sales with scalable tools for your online business.
Does my business need ecommerce software?
Today's connected customer has high expectations. They interact with retail brands through many touchpoints — web, mobile, social, marketplaces, store, ads, and connected devices — and they want to buy in the moment, at any of these touchpoints. They expect each interaction to run smoothly, and for all interactions to be coordinated into a single, unified experience.
